themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 10 champion buffs, 3 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Believe in the heart of the cards... the Tarot cards. Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.tldr: Base damage increased to 75–175 (3 ranks) from 60–120 (3 ranks).
champions.gameplayImpact: Ahri is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
